subject: planner: simplify some estimation code (#64953)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs first parent: it consolidates integer-handle range estimation into `cardinality.GetRowCountByColumnRanges(..., pkIsHandle)` (removing `GetRowCountByIntColumnRanges`), makes the internal column-range estimator unexported (`GetColumnRowCount` -> `getColumnRowCount`), and updates all call sites/tests accordingly (pk/handle paths pass `pkIsHandle=true`, others pass `false`). No Blocker/High issues found in correctness/semantics/concurrency; later history up to `upstream/master` shows subsequent unrelated estimator tweaks/refactors in the touched files, not a follow-up fix for this change.
